categories.title: Gum Care (Periodontics)
categories.short: Bleeding, puffy or receding gums treated by the clinic's own periodontist.
intro: Gums that bleed when you brush are not normal wear and tear. Bleeding is usually the first sign of gum inflammation (gingivitis), and left alone it can progress to periodontitis, where the bone holding the teeth slowly shrinks and teeth may loosen.

Gum care is the clinic's home speciality. Dr. Sindhu measures the gum pockets around each tooth, explains what she finds, and plans treatment from a thorough deep clean through to gum surgery when it is genuinely needed.

steps.title: Gum check
steps.text: Pocket depths are measured around every tooth and X-rays taken if required.

steps.title: Deep clean
steps.text: Hardened deposits are removed from above and below the gum line, usually over one or two visits.

steps.title: Review and maintain
steps.text: Healing is checked after a few weeks and a maintenance interval is agreed.

subTreatments.title: Deep cleaning (scaling and root planing)
subTreatments.summary: Cleans the root surfaces below the gum line so the gum can re-attach.

subTreatments.title: Gum surgery (flap surgery)
subTreatments.summary: For deep pockets that do not settle with cleaning alone.

subTreatments.title: Gum depigmentation
subTreatments.summary: Lightens dark patches on the gums for an even colour.

subTreatments.title: Crown lengthening
subTreatments.summary: Reshapes gum and bone to expose more tooth, for a restoration or a gummy smile.

subTreatments.title: Periodontal maintenance
subTreatments.summary: Regular professional cleans that keep treated gum disease stable.

faqs.q: Is it normal for gums to bleed when I brush?
faqs.a: Occasional bleeding is common, but it is not healthy. Regular bleeding usually means the gums are inflamed, and an examination can show whether a simple clean or deeper treatment is needed.
The area is numbed first, so most people feel pressure rather than pain. Some tenderness for a day or two afterwards is common.

seo.title: Gum Treatment & Periodontist in Tadepalli
seo.description: Bleeding or receding gums? See the periodontist at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic, Ashramam Road, Tadepalli, for gum checks, deep cleaning and gum surgery.

categories.title: General Dentistry
categories.short: Check-ups, fillings, sensitivity and children's dental visits.
intro: Most dental problems are easier, quicker and cheaper to fix when they are small. A check-up looks at your teeth, gums, bite and the soft tissues of the mouth, and tells you honestly whether anything needs attention now or can simply be watched.
Children are welcome from their first tooth. Early visits help them get used to the dental chair before there is ever a problem to treat.

steps.title: Talk
steps.text: Tell us what is bothering you, your medical history and any medicines you take.

steps.title: Examine
steps.text: Teeth, gums and mouth are checked; X-rays only when they add useful information.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: You get the options, the number of visits and the cost before anything is done.

subTreatments.title: Dental consultation and check-up
subTreatments.summary: A full look at teeth, gums and mouth with a clear written plan.

subTreatments.title: Tooth-coloured fillings
subTreatments.summary: Repairs small cavities with a filling matched to your tooth shade.

subTreatments.title: Tooth sensitivity treatment
subTreatments.summary: Finds the cause of the twinge with hot, cold or sweet food and treats it.

subTreatments.title: Emergency toothache care
subTreatments.summary: Same-day relief for sudden pain or swelling, with the cause treated afterwards.

subTreatments.title: Children's dental check-ups
subTreatments.summary: Gentle first visits, cavity checks and brushing advice for parents.

faqs.q: How often should I have a check-up?
faqs.a: Many adults do well with a check-up every six months, but the right interval depends on your gums and cavity risk. The dentist will suggest one for you.

faqs.q: At what age should my child first see a dentist?
faqs.a: Around the first birthday or when the first teeth appear is a good time for a short, friendly visit.

seo.title: Dental Check-ups & Fillings in Tadepalli
seo.description: Check-ups, tooth-coloured fillings, sensitivity care and children's visits at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic on Ashramam Road, Tadepalli.

categories.title: Root Canal Treatment
categories.short: Specialist root canal care that aims to keep your own tooth.
intro: When decay or a crack reaches the pulp inside a tooth, the nerve can become inflamed or infected. The result is often lingering pain, swelling or sensitivity that does not fade. Root canal treatment removes the damaged pulp, cleans and seals the canals, and lets you keep the tooth.
Treatment is carried out by Dr. Naveen Kumar, an endodontist, under local anaesthetic. Most people say the procedure itself feels much like having a filling.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.text: An X-ray and tests show which tooth is affected and how far the infection has spread.

steps.title: Clean and seal
steps.text: The canals are cleaned, shaped and filled, usually over one to three sittings.

steps.title: Protect
steps.text: A back tooth usually needs a crown afterwards so it does not crack.

subTreatments.title: Root canal treatment
subTreatments.summary: Removes infected pulp and seals the tooth from the inside.

subTreatments.title: Re-root canal treatment
subTreatments.summary: Re-treats an earlier root canal that has become painful or infected again.

subTreatments.title: Pulp therapy for children
subTreatments.summary: Treats infected milk teeth so they can stay until the adult tooth is ready.

subTreatments.title: Crown after root canal
subTreatments.summary: A protective cap that restores strength to the treated tooth.

faqs.a: The tooth is numbed first, so most people feel little during treatment. The aim of the procedure is to relieve the pain the infection was causing.

faqs.q: Why not just remove the tooth?
faqs.a: Keeping your natural tooth usually protects your bite and the neighbouring teeth. Removal is an option, and the dentist will talk you through both.

seo.title: Root Canal Specialist in Tadepalli
seo.description: Root canal treatment, re-treatment and children's pulp therapy with an endodontist at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic, Ashramam Road, Tadepalli.

categories.title: Oral & Dental Surgery
categories.short: Wisdom teeth, surgical extractions and minor oral surgery.
intro: Some teeth cannot be saved, and some — like wisdom teeth trapped under the gum — cause repeated swelling and pain. Removing them carefully, with the least disturbance to the bone and gum, makes healing faster and more comfortable.
Surgery is carried out by Dr. Preethi, an oral and maxillofacial surgeon, who also handles small cysts, biopsies and jaw joint consultations.

steps.title: Assess
steps.text: An X-ray shows the root shape and position before anything is planned.

steps.title: Procedure
steps.text: Local anaesthetic is used; you will know what to expect at each step.

steps.title: Aftercare
steps.text: Written care instructions and a review visit to check healing.

subTreatments.title: Wisdom tooth removal
subTreatments.summary: Removes impacted or troublesome wisdom teeth.

subTreatments.title: Surgical and difficult extractions
subTreatments.summary: For broken-down teeth or curved roots that need a surgical approach.

subTreatments.title: Minor oral surgery (cysts, biopsies)
subTreatments.summary: Removal or sampling of small lumps and cysts in the mouth.

subTreatments.title: Jaw and facial bone injury care
subTreatments.summary: Assessment and management of injuries to the jaw and face.

subTreatments.title: Jaw joint (TMJ) pain consultation
subTreatments.summary: Clicking, locking or aching in front of the ear examined and treated.

faqs.q: Do all wisdom teeth need to come out?
faqs.a: No. Wisdom teeth that come in straight and can be cleaned often stay. Removal is advised when they cause repeated pain, infection or damage to the tooth in front.

faqs.q: How long does healing take after an extraction?
faqs.a: The gum usually closes over within one to two weeks. Following the aftercare instructions helps avoid a dry socket.

seo.title: Wisdom Tooth Removal & Oral Surgery, Tadepalli
seo.description: Wisdom tooth removal, surgical extractions and minor oral surgery by an oral & maxillofacial surgeon at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic, Tadepalli.

categories.title: Dental Implants
categories.short: Fixed replacements for missing teeth, planned around healthy gums and bone.
intro: An implant is a small titanium post placed in the jawbone that acts as a new root. Once it has bonded with the bone, a crown, bridge or denture is fixed on top. Implants do not rely on the neighbouring teeth for support.

Healthy gums and enough bone matter as much as the implant itself. Your first consultation is with Dr. Sindhu, who checks the gums and plans the case; the surgical stage is carried out by Dr. Preethi.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Gums, bone and bite are checked, with a scan where needed.

steps.title: Place
steps.text: The implant is placed under local anaesthetic and left to heal.

steps.title: Restore
steps.text: After healing, usually a few months, the final tooth is fitted.

subTreatments.title: Single-tooth implant
subTreatments.summary: Replaces one missing tooth without touching the teeth beside it.

subTreatments.title: Multiple implants / implant-supported bridge
subTreatments.summary: Two or more implants carrying a fixed bridge.

subTreatments.title: Full-arch implant solutions
subTreatments.summary: A fixed set of teeth on several implants for a whole jaw.

subTreatments.title: Implant-supported dentures
subTreatments.summary: A denture that clips onto implants so it stays firm.

subTreatments.title: Bone grafting and sinus lift
subTreatments.summary: Builds up bone where there is not enough to hold an implant.

faqs.q: Am I suitable for an implant?
faqs.a: Most healthy adults are. Uncontrolled diabetes, heavy smoking and active gum disease can affect healing, so these are checked and managed first.

faqs.q: How long does the whole process take?
faqs.a: Commonly three to six months from placement to the final tooth, depending on bone healing and whether grafting is needed.

seo.title: Dental Implants in Tadepalli
seo.description: Single-tooth implants, implant bridges and implant dentures planned around healthy gums at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic, Ashramam Road, Tadepalli.

categories.title: Cleaning & Prevention
categories.short: Scaling, polishing, fluoride, sealants and fresh-breath care.
intro: Even careful brushing leaves plaque in places the brush cannot reach, and in time it hardens into tartar that only a professional clean can remove. A regular clean keeps gums calm and teeth easier to look after.
Prevention for children — fluoride and fissure sealants — helps protect new back teeth during the years they are most prone to decay.

steps.title: Check
steps.text: Gums and plaque levels are checked first.

steps.title: Clean
steps.text: Tartar is removed and the teeth are polished.

steps.title: Coach
steps.text: Simple brushing and flossing tips suited to your mouth.

subTreatments.title: Scaling and polishing
subTreatments.summary: Removes tartar and surface stains.

subTreatments.title: Fluoride application
subTreatments.summary: Strengthens enamel against decay.

subTreatments.title: Pit and fissure sealants for children
subTreatments.summary: A thin protective coat on the grooves of back teeth.

subTreatments.title: Bad-breath care and hygiene counselling
subTreatments.summary: Finds the cause of persistent bad breath and how to manage it.

faqs.q: Will cleaning make my teeth loose?
faqs.a: No. Cleaning removes tartar that was sitting where gum should be. Teeth can feel different for a few days as the gums settle.

faqs.q: How often do I need a professional clean?
faqs.a: Every six months suits many people; those with gum disease may need it more often.

seo.title: Teeth Cleaning & Scaling in Tadepalli
seo.description: Scaling and polishing, fluoride, sealants for children and bad-breath care at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic, Ashramam Road, Tadepalli.

categories.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
categories.short: Whitening, bonding, veneers and gum contouring for a more even smile.
intro: Small changes can make a big difference to how comfortable you feel smiling: lighter teeth, a chipped edge repaired, or an uneven gum line balanced. Cosmetic work at the clinic always starts with healthy gums, because a new smile only lasts on a healthy base.
Dr. Sindhu discusses what is realistic for your teeth and shows you the options before you decide.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Tell us what you would like to change.

steps.title: Check health
steps.text: Gums and teeth are checked so treatment lasts.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: Options, number of visits and cost are explained up front.

subTreatments.title: Teeth whitening
subTreatments.summary: Professionally supervised lightening of natural teeth.

subTreatments.title: Smile makeover
subTreatments.summary: A combined plan that may include whitening, bonding and gum shaping.

subTreatments.title: Veneers and laminates
subTreatments.summary: Thin facings that change the shape or shade of front teeth.

subTreatments.title: Tooth-coloured bonding
subTreatments.summary: Repairs chips and small gaps with tooth-coloured material.

subTreatments.title: Gum contouring
subTreatments.summary: Evens out the gum line for a more balanced smile.

faqs.a: When it is supervised and the right strength is used, whitening is considered safe for enamel. Some temporary sensitivity is common.

faqs.q: Will whitening change my fillings or crowns?
faqs.a: No. Whitening only lightens natural teeth, so visible fillings may need replacing afterwards to match.

seo.description: Teeth whitening, bonding, veneers and gum contouring at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic on Ashramam Road, Tadepalli.

categories.title: Dentures
categories.short: Complete, partial and flexible dentures, plus repairs and relines.
intro: Dentures replace missing teeth with a removable plate. A well-made denture helps with chewing, speech and the support of the cheeks and lips.
Your first consultation is with Dr. Sindhu, who checks the gums and remaining teeth and explains the options.

steps.title: Examine
steps.text: Gums and remaining teeth are assessed.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: Impressions and bite records are taken over a few visits.

steps.title: Fit
steps.text: The denture is fitted and adjusted until it is comfortable.

subTreatments.title: Complete dentures
subTreatments.summary: A full set for a jaw with no remaining teeth.

subTreatments.title: Partial dentures
subTreatments.summary: Fills gaps while keeping your remaining natural teeth.

subTreatments.title: Flexible dentures
subTreatments.summary: A lighter, bendable base without metal clasps.

subTreatments.title: Denture repair and relining
subTreatments.summary: Fixes cracks and refits a loose denture.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get used to a new denture?
faqs.a: Most people adapt within a few weeks. Sore spots are common at first and can be eased with small adjustments.

faqs.q: Should I sleep with my denture in?
faqs.a: It is usually advised to take dentures out at night to rest the gums, and to clean them daily.

seo.title: Dentures in Tadepalli — Complete & Partial
seo.description: Complete, partial and flexible dentures, repairs and relines at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic, Ashramam Road, Tadepalli.

categories.title: Braces & Aligners
categories.short: Straighter teeth with braces or clear aligners for children and adults.
intro: Crooked, crowded or gapped teeth can be harder to clean as well as affecting your confidence. Braces and clear aligners move teeth gradually into a better position.
Start with a consultation with Dr. Sindhu, who checks that the gums are healthy enough for tooth movement and explains the next steps.

steps.title: Consult
steps.text: Teeth, bite and gums are examined.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Records are taken and the options explained.

steps.title: Treat and retain
steps.text: Regular reviews during treatment, then a retainer to hold the result.

subTreatments.title: Metal braces
subTreatments.summary: Reliable fixed braces with reviews every 4–6 weeks.

subTreatments.title: Ceramic (tooth-coloured) braces
subTreatments.summary: Fixed braces that blend in with the teeth.

subTreatments.title: Clear aligners
subTreatments.summary: Removable transparent trays changed every few weeks.

subTreatments.title: Retainers
subTreatments.summary: Keep teeth in place after braces or aligners.

subTreatments.title: Early orthodontic check for children
subTreatments.summary: A bite check from around 7 years of age.

faqs.q: Am I too old for braces?
faqs.a: There is no upper age limit as long as the gums and bone are healthy.

faqs.q: Braces or aligners — which is better?
faqs.a: Both can work well. The choice depends on the type of correction needed, lifestyle and budget, and is discussed at the consultation.

seo.title: Braces & Clear Aligners in Tadepalli
seo.description: Consultations for metal braces, ceramic braces and clear aligners at Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic, Ashramam Road, Tadepalli.
